**Finding: compliant** (RENEWAL — Auto-renewal and non-renewal notice window)

§§ 8.2–8.3 satisfy the **preferred** position on all material terms, so no redline was proposed:

| Term | Playbook preferred | Document |
|---|---|---|
| Renewal term | 12 months | Successive twelve-month periods (§ 8.2) |
| Customer opt-out | 30 days' notice | 30 days' written notice (§ 8.2) |
| Vendor reminder | 60 days pre-renewal | 60 days beforehand, **plus** deadline extension if missed (§ 8.2) |
| Price uplift | Lesser of CPI and 3% | Lesser of CPI (trailing 12 months) and 3%, 90 days' notice, none on prepaid periods (§ 8.3) |

Two points worth noting for the file, neither a deviation: the missed-reminder extension in § 8.2 and the "no increase on prepaid periods" carve-out in § 8.3 are both better than our preferred baseline. § 8.1 sets a three-year master term, but that is the agreement term rather than an auto-renewing period, and expiration expressly does not cut off live Order Forms — so it does not raise the walk-away concern about automatic multi-year renewals.
